pages.text: Look for small, round green buttons in sandy parts of deserts, badlands and other eligible dry or savanna biomes. Check desert greenhouses or a novice dealer for another source.

pages.title: Sand Garden
pages.text: Place the peyote item directly on regular or red sand. Bonemeal advances the plant through four sizes. Break the largest plant for four peyote. Save one to replant and $(l:psychedelicraft:preparations/peyote)dry the rest$(/l).
